description: Java entity class representing calendar history entries in the Fineract project, including fields for dates, recurrence, and reminders, with methods for date comparisons and updates.

classes.name: CalendarHistory
classes.description: Entity class for storing historical calendar data, including start/end dates, recurrence, and reminders.

methods.name: getRecurrence
methods.description: Returns the recurrence pattern of the calendar history.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the calendar history.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the calendar history.

methods.name: isStartDateBeforeOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the start date is before or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isEndDateAfterOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the end date is after or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isBetweenStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Checks if a date falls between start and end dates.

methods.name: updateEndDate
methods.description: Updates the end date of the calendar history.
